coverage:
Read-only, measured 2026-09-29 ~04:00 UTC.
- Memory: all notes.json files on node 1 (substrate-live) and node 2 (compose2-live), plus node 1's 3 .bak files, copied out with docker cp and parsed on the host. Also read: memory-note.ts from the live dev-vessel clone, the dev-vessel journal from 09-25 13:10 to 09-26 05:13, and one live memoryNote resolve on node 2.
- Pool: standing.json on both nodes. Parsed 4 of the 21 orphaned tmp snapshots on node 1. Aggregated the full drain-log on both nodes and the watchdog-log on node 1. Replayed boredom's two read requests on node 1 :8090.
- Runtime state: policies/, state/, leases/ on both nodes.
- Concept-db: SQL counts and group-bys on concept and concept_usage, plus a listing of the 57 compose_lessons.
- Not read: node 1 gaps/ contents, trace-spool, concept_edge beyond a count, mitosis-applied.jsonl, the other 17 tmp snapshots, node 2's watchdog log.

problems.symptom: The authoritative memory holds 59 notes, the oldest from 09-26 05:12. The 1184 knowledge notes from before the wipe survive only in an unread .bak. Recall ignores topic.
problems.root_cause: A flat JSON store with an env-derived path. Recall is newest-N. loadNotes swallows errors and returns [], and saveNotes then persists that. All writers share one .tmp path. The store is per node. The 09-26 wipe cause is UNVERIFIED; the window is 05:11:20–05:12:02 UTC.

problems.symptom: Memory, rhythm posteriors, jointBindings, llm-model-policy (rev 25 vs 9) and policy files all differ between node 1 and node 2. Operator containment and rebaselines reach node 1 only.
problems.root_cause: Every node keeps its own super-repo runtime dirs (pool, memory, policies, state). No shape carries the learning state to the hub.

problems.symptom: All 1805 boredomSelectionSnapshots record open_gap_count 0 and rhythms_consulted [].
problems.root_cause: The snapshot writer reads top-level total/items, but the data is under body.gaps/body.impulses (confirmed by replay). The scorer reads correctly: two readers of one seam with divergent envelopes.

problems.symptom: Whole-body or whole-file rewrites lose concurrent or omitted data: the rhythm containment wiped by 329fc5c, the memory store wiped, gap store keys carried forward, torn pool tmps.
problems.root_cause: Read-modify-write of an entire record or file, with no versioning and no fail-closed read

problems.symptom: Since 09-22, 99.6% of the 2256 dispatches on node 1 went to 3 gaps; the db_performance gap has been re-detected every tick for 11 days
problems.root_cause: Gaps with falsifier none are re-detected and re-dispatched with no terminal disposition. The remedy-livelock gaps did not stop it.

problems.symptom: Autonomy admission was widened and tightened twice in 48h: ~250 to 2-5, then widened, then 8 landings with 1 improvement, then tightened again
problems.root_cause: No machine-measurable criterion decides supply against quality; the operator hand-edits one pool record

problems.symptom: The gap-compose watchdog restarts with ok:true while the stall continues (stalled_min up to 241, 383 open intents); the expectation-scan heartbeat reports checked:0; discardedLandingReport is always 0
problems.root_cause: Detectors act or report without checking that their action changed the condition

problems.symptom: Walks satisfy memoryNote_write by writing files named memoryNote* into the super-repo root; schema-echo pool rows (id 'string', body 'object'); 15 identical 'Investigation of Slow Queries' notes
problems.root_cause: shellResult satisfiers and LLM notes count as producing the shape

problems.symptom: Runtime residue: 21 orphaned standing.json.tmp files (~100MB); an unbounded 180MB drain-log; 1805 never-retired snapshots; 30+ residue files in the super-repo root; {{placeholder}} files and titles; compiled .js beside .ts in boredom src
problems.root_cause: No retention or cleanup for runtime logs and snapshots; template placeholders are not rendered before writes

problems.symptom: None of the 57 compose_lessons has a success credit, though 42 were loaded (up to 85 times); lessons are duplicated (anchor_not_found ≥5 variants) and some are empty boilerplate
problems.root_cause: Lesson efficacy is never credited back (PLAUSIBLE); a new lesson is minted per failure instead of reinforcing an existing one

problems.symptom: A capability-level need ('the system cannot remember') found no target shape and ended hollow
problems.root_cause: Target inference cannot map capability words to the memoryNote shape that the same node serves

problems.symptom: detect-drift commit-and-push committed 422 .bun cache binaries and runtime state into dev-vessel
problems.root_cause: The commit step stages runtime and cache paths

problems.symptom: The untrack commit 50830bec deleted learning-mode-state.json on pull, resetting learning mode; the pool's oldest record is 09-27, and the absence of records from 09-22 to 09-26 is unexplained
problems.root_cause: Runtime state lives inside a git clone that pulls mutate

problems.symptom: The memory path depends on WORKSPACE_ROOT, which the unit sets to /workspace and the env file sets to /workspace/git/super-repo (both still present); policy files are missing on node 2
problems.root_cause: Store locations and behavior tunables live in env and files, not in shapes

principles: autonomous work may not land on what lands, verifies, grades or constrains autonomy; the learner earns its core after landing cleanly on the periphery (autonomyScope.reason 09-27)
a landing without a pre-existing machine check cannot be credited (autonomyScope 09:15Z)
budget>1 is never affordable = the effective pause; containment works through budget, not a pause field (project-intake rhythm)
Law 5 observability: each tick's condition-driven selection is published as a snapshot (boredom index.ts:53); the intent is right but the record is hollow
read WORKSPACE_ROOT at use time; behaviour frozen at process start is invisible to traces (memory-note.ts:55-73)
the commit step stages only source trees, never runtime or cache paths (self-maintenance lift_when)
a store whose path is env-derived can silently fork; recency-window recall plus an unbounded writer = amnesia by displacement (operator 09-22)
derived: a store that turns a failed read into an empty write converts any transient fault into total loss; fixes that leave the storage primitive unchanged get undone by the next incident
